text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, Umatter trending topics.
It's Kita-chan.

text_block_list.name: SNS
text_block_list.text:
“Kitasan Black, great job in the Takarazuka Kinen!
That was one huge challenge!”

text_block_list.name: SNS
text_block_list.text:
"Because nobody has ever achieved the Spring Senior Triple Crown!
It was so thrilling! I was cheering so hard!"
"I love Kitasan's attitude!" "Keep it up!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The Spring Senior Triple Crown, you mean that thing...
Where you win the three GⅠs: the Osaka Hai, Tenno Sho (Spring), and Takarazuka Kinen, right?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And it's an unprecedented record...
Kita-chan's taking on that challenge too, huh...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —...Yeah. I'm gonna do it! Me too!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Winning and having fun!
I'm going to pull off both!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ding♪)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Huh, from Vodka-chan?
...An invite to a LANE group?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Group name: "Aim for the World!"—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
“Kiseki-san.
Please let me know if you ever need any advice.”

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "Do your best, Kiseki."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Heheheh...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ――"Thank you so much!!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp starts today!
Days of staying at the special facility
and pouring everything into training begin!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
...I'll show you I can do it.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's the heart-pounding thrill of not knowing the outcome!
It's seeing the protagonist struggle with all her might!
That's what makes everyone get so hooked on a story!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —As long as we keep taking on challenges, winning and entertaining can go hand in hand!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm going to challenge it!
I want to try clearing a goal so high it makes you look up in awe!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Just like the day I first became the protagonist!
And to reach out for the impossible!!
choice_data_list: Yeah! I'll help with that too! Absolutely!
Yeah! I'll help with that too! Absolutely!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Please!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki and I lock eyes and share a smile.
I want to see her create her greatest masterpiece
and emerge as its victor—and get thrilled by it!
choice_data_list: Let's take on our "biggest challenge" in the next race!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...!
The ultimate challenge...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Does that mean...?
choice_data_list: Our homework is for both of us to think about that.
Our homework is for both of us to think about that.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, ahahaha!
Sounds good!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll go brainstorm a super exciting,
thrilling challenge for us!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, summer training camp began!
